key.name: data-dir
key.summary: Folder for latest.json and history.json (empty = ~/.local/share/xdrip-topbar)

key.name: active
key.summary: Join the group visibly (roll call + battery requests)

key.name: rollcall-name
key.summary: Name shown in xDrip+ followers list when active

key.name: key-stamp
key.summary: Bumped by the settings window whenever the sync key in the keyring changes

key.name: data-source
key.summary: Where the readings come from: xDrip+ Cloud Sync or a Nightscout site

key.name: nightscout-url
key.summary: Nightscout address, e.g. https://mysite.example.com (the token or API secret is kept in the keyring)

key.name: units
key.summary: Show glucose in mmol/L or mg/dL (limits are stored in mmol/L either way)

key.name: python
key.summary: Python interpreter used to run the collector

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Where the reading sits in the top bar

key.name: low-mmol
key.summary: Below this is low (mmol/L)

key.name: high-mmol
key.summary: Above this is high (mmol/L)

key.name: value-color-low
key.summary: Glucose value colour when low

key.name: value-color-in
key.summary: Glucose value colour when in range

key.name: value-color-high
key.summary: Glucose value colour when high

key.name: arrow-color-low
key.summary: Trend arrow colour when low

key.name: arrow-color-in
key.summary: Trend arrow colour when in range

key.name: arrow-color-high
key.summary: Trend arrow colour when high

key.name: arrow-same-as-value
key.summary: Use the glucose value colours for the arrow too

key.name: stale-minutes
key.summary: Minutes without a reading before the top bar shows the data as stale

key.name: stale-color
key.summary: Colour for stale data

key.name: history-mode
key.summary: Show the history as a dropdown or as a separate window

key.name: graph-show-line
key.summary: Draw a line through the readings

key.name: graph-smooth
key.summary: Smooth curve instead of straight segments

key.name: graph-line-width
key.summary: Line width (pixels)

key.name: graph-line-color-mode
key.summary: Colour the line by range, or one colour

key.name: graph-line-color
key.summary: Line colour when using one colour

key.name: graph-show-dots
key.summary: Show a dot for every reading

key.name: graph-gap-minutes
key.summary: Break the line where readings are further apart than this

key.name: graph-fill-gaps
key.summary: Bridge gaps in the readings with a line in the gap colour

key.name: graph-gap-color
key.summary: Colour of the line that bridges a gap

key.name: graph-hours
key.summary: Hours shown in the graph (mouse-wheel zoom, remembered)

key.name: graph-event-info
key.summary: Where the details of a clicked graph item appear: a popup next to it, or the status line

key.name: dropdown-width
key.summary: Dropdown graph width

key.name: dropdown-height
key.summary: Dropdown graph height

key.name: window-width
key.summary: History window width

key.name: window-height
key.summary: History window height
